questions.text: Suppose that in an IP-over-Ethernet network, a machine X wishes to find the MAC address of another machine Y in its subnet. Which one of the following techniques can be used for this?
questions.solution:
ARP request: X does not know Y's MAC, so it sends the request to the broadcast MAC address (FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF) in its subnet, carrying Y's IP. Only Y replies, with its MAC.

The gateway is not involved (Y is in the same subnet), and ARP does not use a broadcast IP address.

Answer: X sends an ARP request packet with broadcast MAC address in its local subnet

options: X sends an ARP request packet to the local gateway's IP address which then finds the  MAC address of Y and sends to X
X sends an ARP request packet to the local gateway's MAC address which then finds the MAC address of Y and sends to X
X sends an ARP request packet with broadcast MAC address in its local subnet
X sends an ARP request packet with broadcast IP address in its local subnet

questions.text: Consider three machines M, N and P with IP addresses 100.10.5.2, 100.10.5.5 and 100.10.5.6 respectively. The subnet mask is set to 255.255.255.252 for all the three machines. Which one of the following is true?
questions.solution:
Mask 255.255.255.252 = /30, so subnets are blocks of 4 in the last octet.
- M: .2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] block .0-.3
- N: .5 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] block .4-.7
- P: .6 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] block .4-.7

Answer: Only N and P belong to the same subnet

options: M, N and P all belong to the same subnet
Only M and N belong to the same subnet
Only N and P belong to the same subnet
M, N, and P belong to three different subnets

questions.text: Which of the following protocol pairs can be used to send and retrieve e-mails (in that order)?
questions.solution:
SMTP is used to send (push) mail. POP3 (or IMAP) is used to retrieve mail from the mailbox. MIME is only a format for attachments.

Answer: SMTP, POP3

options: IMAP POP3
SMTP, POP3
SMTP, MIME
IMAP, SMTP

questions.text: Which one of the following algorithm is not used in asymmetric key cryptography?
questions.solution:
RSA and Diffie-Hellman are public-key (asymmetric) algorithms. Electronic Code Book is a mode of operation for symmetric block ciphers.

Answer: Electronic Code Book Algorithm

questions.text: What is one advantage of setting up a DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) with two firewalls?
questions.solution:
With two firewalls, the DMZ sits between the outside network and the internal network, and each firewall has its own rules. This lets you control exactly which traffic may flow between the Internet, the DMZ and the internal network.

Answer: You can control where traffic goes in the three networks
